description: This file implements the 'Image_Color' class, which provides functionality for color manipulation, conversion between color formats (hex, RGB, HSV), color mixing, and related utilities within an image processing context. It handles color operations such as blending, color range generation, lightness adjustment, and color readability analysis.

classes.name: Image_Color
classes.description: Handles color conversion, mixing, and utilities for image processing, supporting multiple color formats and operations like blending, lightness adjustment, and generating color ranges.

methods.name: mixColors
methods.description: Mixes two colors by averaging their RGB components, with optional web-safe rounding.

methods.name: setWebSafe
methods.description: Sets whether output colors should be limited to Web-safe palette.

methods.name: setColors
methods.description: Sets the two primary colors used for mixing and ranges.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Generates a sequence of colors between the two set colors, spaced by specified degrees.

methods.name: changeLightness
methods.description: Adjusts the lightness (brightness) of the stored colors.

methods.name: getTextColor
methods.description: Determines whether black or white text would be more readable on a given background color.

methods.name: _setColors
methods.description: Internal method to set the internal color arrays from color inputs.

methods.name: _splitColor
methods.description: Converts a color string (hex with or without '#') into an RGB array.

methods.name: rgb2hex
methods.description: Converts an RGB array to a hexadecimal color string.

methods.name: hex2rgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB array, including the original hex.

methods.name: hsv2hex
methods.description: Converts HSV values to a hex color string.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color in an image resource based on provided color.

methods.name: color2RGB
methods.description: Converts various color input formats to an RGB array.

methods.name: namedColor2RGB
methods.description: Converts a named color to an RGB array, or black if unknown.

methods.name: getTextColor
methods.description: Determines suitable text color (black or white) based on background brightness.

methods.name: _returnColor
methods.description: Deprecated: Converts RGB to hex color string.
